note: Adapted from Hill's (1942) species-level description, the original in English; the original description is Silvestri's 1909 (Fauna Südwest-Australiens). Measurements in mm. Distribution: Coolgardie (type locality), Kalgoorlie, G-hooli (defective in the OCR, place name incomplete), Merredin, Northam, Wongan Hills, Seabrook, Mundaring, Hovea, Jigalong, Derby and Wyndham in Western Australia; Normanville and Cambrai in South Australia; Linga in Victoria; Menindie in New South Wales; Cunnamulla and Morven in Queensland. Type material: the soldier holotype in the Swedish Museum of Natural History, Stockholm, and an alate morphotype in the South Australian Museum. OCR problems: 'Ringed adult' is a misreading of 'Winged adult'; 'Pronotum, wide - 0.73' is a single value in the original.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Almost entirely very dark brown; postclypeus slightly paler than the head; tarsi pale yellow-brown; wings dark smoky. It differs from M. biroi in the darker colour (especially the legs and the underside), the paler tarsi and the smaller size; from all mainland species it differs in the darker colour and the obvious contrast between the tarsi and the rest of the legs (Fig. 332). Measurements (mm): body length with wings 9.40—10.50; body length without wings 4.50—5.60; head length (to apex of labrum) 0.91—1.06; head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.57—0.64; head width 0.85—0.88; maximum diameter of compound eye 0.18—0.22; ocellus length 0.07—0.09; pronotum length 0.40—0.45; pronotum width 0.73; forewing length 7.75—8.40; forewing width 1.88—2.05.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head orange to orange-red-brown, usually darkest anteriorly. Head (Fig. 333) with a very high length-to-width ratio. Mandibles far shorter than the head capsule, very stout, the sides straight, the apex abruptly incurved, the tip rather blunt. Frons slightly convex, clearly delimited, with a small but fairly distinct median depression near the clypeofrontal suture. It is easily distinguished from other species by the long, narrow head and the short, stout mandibles. Measurements (mm): body length 5.10—7.75; head length including mandibles 2.45—2.86; head length (to clypeal suture) 1.72—1.96; head width 0.87—0.98; pronotum length 0.31—0.36; pronotum width 0.58—0.66.
